features: all-weather gyro-stabilized long-range day/night PTZ camera system
2MP / 4MP / 8MP CMOS, HD lens with 22x/30x/36x/38x/49x optical zoom (visible lens up to 272mm)
optional ZLID laser IR illumination up to 2km night vision in complete darkness
optional thermal imaging for long-range detection up to 20km (up to 275mm thermal lens)
integrated optical fog filter on select models
RS485/Pelco-D or Octagon Bridge/API control, slew-to-cue via NMEA 0183
optional GPS & 4G cellular, integrated internal storage, wide-angle 4K spotter camera
rugged IP67, -30 to +60C, strengthened aluminum housing
release_notes: Configurable multi-sensor PTZ positioner; resolution/zoom/thermal are payload options (2-8MP, 22x-49x visible, optional thermal to 275mm).
